title: The Call of the Spacetime Rift
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to grasp the truth, the spacetime rift abruptly contracted, Chen Tianming's voice cutting off mid-sentence, leaving only a chilling whisper: 'The seventh page will be your final trump card.'

text.content: The night sky over the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain was dark as ink, Han Lie's stumbling retreating figure long vanished into the deep forest. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back at the cliff's edge, moonlight carving cold, sharp contours on his profile. The slight upturn of his lips carried a smile so detached it bordered on mockery—the Xuanwu Sect's number one prodigy, nothing more. He glanced down at his palm, where the sensation of having just stepped on Han Lie's face still lingered, soft and disappointingly so. The weak rage, slashing at those even weaker; the strong rage, slashing at those even stronger. But Chen Ji never raged—he only calculated. Distant whispers from fellow disciples fell on deaf ears as he turned toward his dilapidated dwelling. What he didn't know was that deep within the stars that night, an invisible rift was quietly tearing open.

Returning to his quarters, Chen Ji shut the creaking wooden door behind him. The room's furnishings were简陋 to the point of destitution—a low bed, an oil lamp, a few scrolls of yellowed功法 fragments—these were all the possessions of a Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple. He sat cross-legged on the bed, closed his eyes, and sank his consciousness deep into the Mental Sea. The Tianji Record Fragment floated in the混沌, emanating a faint blue glow. Yet just then, that blue light suddenly violently trembled, as if some force was desperately撞击 an invisible barrier. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, pupils constricting—such异象 had never occurred before. He rose abruptly, gaze fixed死死 on a thin crack slowly tearing open in the void.

dialogue.content: Who?! Chen Ji's voice was cold and blade-sharp, his right hand already pressing against the short blade at his waist. He scanned his surroundings, confirmed doors and windows were sealed and barriers intact, yet his vigilance only intensified. Whoever had penetrated his三重禁制 was by no means an ordinary cultivator. But then, an aged yet feeble voice drifted from the depths of the void, as if traversing endless years, carrying an indescribable沧桑 and weariness. 'Ji'er... it's me.' Chen Ji's entire body shuddered, his blade nearly slipping from his grasp. That voice—that was unmistakably his father Chen Tianming's voice, missing for years! But Chen Tianming had perished in the Ancient Forbidden Land a decade ago, his remains never recovered. This was established fact throughout the Tianqing Sect, and an永远无法愈合 wound in his heart. He drew a sharp breath, forcefully suppressing his churning emotions, and asked coldly.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, his gaze piercing the void to stare at the flickering rift. His voice was terrifyingly calm, every word seemingly挤出 from between his teeth. From the rift came fragmented whispers, weak as candles guttering in the wind,随时都可能熄灭. Yet the information contained within those whispers made Chen Ji's pupils contract sharply—the core of the ultimate chess player, the Heavenly Fate Key, the conditions for returning... these words exploded in his mind like thunder. He didn't know if this was a genuine calling or an elaborately designed trap. But whatever the case, he had to listen. His father's final words might be the only羁绊 remaining to him in this world.

'My son... listen carefully...' Chen Tianming's voice grew ever more faint, as if it might dissipate in the wind at any moment, 'The core of the ultimate chess player... lies within... the seventh page...' Chen Ji's breath caught abruptly. The seventh page—he possessed only six pages of the incomplete Tianji Record, and that legendary seventh page was said to have been incinerated and destroyed in the ancient war ten thousand years ago. Why would his father know of this? Just as he was about to press for answers, the voice continued: 'Destroy the core... your sister... then...' The words cut off abruptly as the rift violently trembled, a blinding golden light shooting from the void and directly into Chen Ji's brow center. In an instant, countless unfamiliar images flooded his mind—Chen Nian trapped on a blood-red altar, the Holy Sect's conspiracy, and a vague black shadow...

dialogue.content: 'Young master!' Mo Xiansheng's aged voice suddenly erupted in his Mental Sea, carrying unprecedented gravity, 'This is... a spacetime projection! To penetrate重重禁制 and project here, the sender must either be an immensely powerful old monster, or... has some deep connection to the Tianji Record!' Chen Ji offered no reply, the images still churning in his mind. He saw his sister Chen Nian bound by chains atop a blood-red altar, her agonized, distorted face clearly visible; he saw Holy Sect figures in black robes forming a circle, chanting obscure incantations; and he saw himself holding a scroll emanating dazzling golden light, standing before some altar—the scroll's seventh page赫然在目!

text.content: Chen Ji猛然睁眼, cold sweat already soaking through his back. He stared死 at the slowly healing rift, chest heaving. Was this prophecy, or a trap? Was this his father's final gift across the boundaries of life and death, or an elaborate deception by some unknown entity? Whatever the possibility, one thing was certain—his sister Chen Nian was still alive. For ten years he had traversed three sects and five schools, secretly investigated demonic path forbidden lands, all for a single answer. And now, the answer lay before him. He drew a deep breath, voice low but resolute: 'Father, is there anything else you wish to tell me?'

dialogue.content: 'The conditions for returning...' Chen Tianming's voice had become extremely faint, yet still carried undeniable威严, 'To complete the Heavenly Fate ritual... the Heavenly Fate Value must serve as the guide... with a blood relative as the medium...' Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. Heavenly Fate ritual, blood relative medium—did this mean awakening his father required sacrificing the bond between him and his sister? Or did it mean Chen Nian herself would have to pay some kind of price? Just as he was about to press for answers, the rift violently twisted at this moment, as if some force was forcibly dragging everything back. Chen Tianming's voice became fragmented. 'Ji'er... seventh page... the final trump card...' 'Father!' Chen Ji shouted sharply, but could only watch helplessly as the rift suddenly closed before his eyes, leaving only a faint sigh lingering in the air: 'Find her... protect her...'

text.content: The room returned to deathly silence, only the oil lamp's flame微微摇曳. Chen Ji stood alone in the darkness, face如water. Everything just now had felt like an absurd dream, yet the clear images still churning in his mind constantly reminded him—this was real. His father hadn't died, or rather, he existed in some form deep within the spacetime rift; and his sister Chen Nian was imprisoned by the Holy Sect, serving as the so-called 'Heavenly Fate Key.' He looked down at his own hands, where the burning sensation from when the golden light entered his body still seemed to linger. Heavenly Fate Value, seventh page, the core of the ultimate chess player... these fragments spun rapidly in his mind, gradually assembling into a blurry picture.

dialogue.content: 'Young master.' Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, this time with added gravity, 'That projection just now... this old one sensed a familiar aura. That was indeed Chen Tianming's residual soul beyond doubt, but the information he transmitted... is恐怕 far from as simple as it appears.' Chen Ji slowly turned, his gaze deep as an abyss: 'What do you mean,先生?' 'The core of the ultimate chess player, the seventh page, the Heavenly Fate ritual...' Mo Xiansheng articulated each word deliberately, 'These matters, this old one originally shouldn't tell you at this moment. But since the elder has spoken...' He paused, voice growing even lower, 'The original Tianji Record had nine pages. What you see now is only six. The seventh page is the last mechanism left by this old one's brother; as for the eighth and ninth pages... they never existed in this world.'

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze flickered slightly. The ninth page, never existed? Mo Xiansheng's words carried staggering implications. The Tianji Record originally had nine pages—this meant the six fragments he possessed were merely the tip of the iceberg, and the legendary seventh and eighth pages held the true keys. He suddenly recalled the image he saw when the golden light entered his body: himself holding a complete Tianji Record emanating dazzling golden light, standing before an altar. Did that mean collecting all the fragments was the first step to fulfilling his father's dying wish? Or was this itself an elaborately designed deception?

dialogue.content: '先生.' Chen Ji's voice was平静得近乎冷漠, 'You just said the eighth and ninth pages never existed in this world. But if they never existed, then whence comes this "never"?' Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a moment before speaking slowly: 'Young master's insight is as keen as ever. By "never existed," this old one means these two pages never manifested in physical form in this world. They... were预留 positions for specific individuals.' Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly: 'What do you mean?' 'The ninth page of the Tianji Record is a cage预留 for Heavenly Dao's will.' Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly grew grave, 'And the eighth page... is a chessboard for the 'transcender.' Young master, do you truly believe the Tianji Record is nothing more than a divine artifact for foresight?'

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. Mo Xiansheng's words were like a盆冷水, extinguishing most of the hope just ignited in his heart. A cage for Heavenly Dao's will, a chessboard for the transcender—what did these words imply? They meant that this seemingly incomplete divine scroll in his hands was from the very beginning merely a piece in some grand chess game. And his father Chen Tianming, his sister Chen Nian, and even himself... were perhaps all sacrificial pieces in this game. Outside, the night deepened like ink, and from the direction of the Tianqing Sect Main Peak came faint bell tolls in the distance—midnight had arrived, a new day was about to begin. And in Chen Ji's mind, his father's final words continued echoing: The seventh page will be your final trump card.

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming's voice had already dissipated, yet the deeper meaning behind his father's words still kept Chen Ji restless and sleepless. He stood before the window, gazing at the starlight flickering in the night sky, falling into deep contemplation. The core of the ultimate chess player, the task of destroying it, the conditions for returning... all of this pointed to a choice he had to face. And Mo Xiansheng's words just now made him realize he might be situated within a chess game far grander than imagined. At this moment, he needed to make a decision.

choices.text: Immediately investigate the seventh page's whereabouts
choices.description: Father's words still echoed in his ears, and his sister still suffered at the Holy Sect. Time was life itself; every moment of delay meant Chen Nian faced greater danger. Even if dragon's pool and tiger's den lay ahead, he had to depart immediately.
choices.visible_cost: May fall into danger due to insufficient preparation
choices.visible_reward: Seize the initiative, gain the upper hand
choices.risk_hint: Hasty actions may lead into a trap

text.content: Chen Ji turned sharply, a flash of determination flickering in his eyes. Whether ahead lay trap or opportunity, his sister's life permitted not a moment's hesitation. He swiftly gathered the Tianji Record fragments, sealing Mo Xiansheng's voice deep within his Mental Sea: '先生, deduce the timing of the Holy Sect's blood sacrifice ceremony for me.' Mo Xiansheng agreed with a low voice. Chen Ji pushed open the window, night wind rushing in, stirring his garments. A moment later, a black shadow shot out from the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, streaking toward the night sky in the southeast direction. That direction was precisely where the Holy Sect's forbidden lands lay.

choices.text: First verify the authenticity of the information
choices.description: What was just witnessed was too extraordinary—Father's cross-temporal calling, the images of his sister imprisoned, the core of the ultimate chess player... Was any of this real? Acting rashly might lead to utter destruction; better to find a way to verify first before making any decisions.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes time, may miss a golden opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Avoid falling into traps and see the entire situation clearly
choices.risk_hint: The verification process may expose one's intentions

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the impulse in his heart and sat back down on the couch. Blind action was the mark of fools, and he, Chen Ji, never fought without preparation. He closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking once more into the Mental Sea, summoning the Tianji Record Fragment for careful examination. As expected, several faint golden characters had appeared on the fragment—content that had never been there before. Upon closer inspection, it turned out to be an ancient record about the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.' And the source attribution of this record clearly stated four characters: Holy Sect Forbidden Technique. A faint smile tugged at the corner of his mouth—indeed, there was a problem.

choices.text: Contact Ye Qing to discuss grand strategy
choices.description: Ye Qing, the Holy Woman of the Demonic Path, possesses the 'Demonic Mist' which can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record. Moreover, she harbors a blood feud with the Holy Sect that cannot be reconciled. Perhaps her strength can be leveraged to investigate the situation without exposing our own secrets.
choices.visible_cost: Owe favors and reveal part of our trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Gain powerful ally support and reduce risks
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's stance is difficult to gauge—need to guard against counterattack

text.content: Chen Ji contemplated for a moment, then retrieved a black jade talisman from his chest. This was a contact token left by Ye Qing when they parted months ago. He infused spiritual energy into the talisman, and tiny characters appeared on its surface: 'In three days, at Moon-Gazing Cliff, there is an important matter to discuss.' After sending the message, the talisman's glow slowly faded. Chen Ji rose and walked to the window, gazing at the pale dawn gradually brightening the eastern horizon. A complex expression flickered in his eyes. Holy Sect, Ye Qing, Heavenly Fate Lock Key... this game is becoming more and more interesting. He suddenly laughed softly and murmured to himself: 'Come then, let this one see what new tricks this grand play can pull off.'

However, just as Chen Ji was about to make his final decision, the spatiotemporal rift that had already closed began to tremble again. A wisp of faint golden light seeped from the Void, slowly coalescing into a vague human silhouette. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—though the figure's features were indistinct, that posture, that bearing... it was clearly his father, Chen Tianming! Yet in the next moment, Master Mo's urgent warning echoed in his Mental Sea: 'Young master, be careful! This is not the true spirit of Senior Chen Tianming, but rather—' Before he could finish, the golden silhouette exploded into countless specks of light, each containing fragmented images—ancient wars, the birth of the Tianji Record, and a black shadow sealed under countless layers...

Chen Ji clutched his head sharply, those images piercing his consciousness like countless needles. He saw the personification of the Heavenly Will—an enormous eye covering the heavens, gazing down at the earth with cold indifference; he saw the tragic fates of prophetic seers throughout history—they were all manipulated by the Heavenly Will, ultimately becoming discarded pieces in a chess game; he saw his own figure appearing on a massive altar, surrounded by tens of thousands of black-robed figures... 'So that's how it is...' Chen Ji laughed lowly, a flash of enlightenment in his eyes, 'Father, are you warning me or using me?' He slowly raised his head, his gaze piercing through the layers of Void, as if gazing at that Eye of Heavenly Secrets from afar. 'Want to make me a chess piece? Then come try and see who devours whom first.'

Those golden lights piercing his consciousness gradually dissipated, leaving only one final image lingering in Chen Ji's mind—Chen Nian trapped in the center of a blood-red altar, surrounded by Holy Sect black-robed figures conducting some ritual. Her lips moved slightly, as if saying something. Chen Ji probed his consciousness into that image, barely making out his sister's lip movements: 'Brother... hurry... find...' Before she could finish, the image completely dissolved. He rose abruptly, his eyes blazing with fierce light. Regardless of whether those visions were heavenly guidance or traps and coercion, one thing was certain—Chen Nian was still alive and calling for him. Dawn was breaking in the east outside the window, a new day was dawning. And Chen Ji knew that the time remaining for him might already be running out.

At that moment, a soft knock came from the door. 'Brother Chen?' A clear female voice called out, carrying a hint of concern. 'I sensed unusual activity in the Rear Mountain just now—are you alright?' Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly—why would Su Qingyao be here at this hour? He took a deep breath, suppressing all the刚才的震动. His expression returned to the usual timidity and woodenness. 'Sister Su?' He deliberately lowered his voice, tinged with fear, 'What brings you here?' After a moment of silence outside the door, Su Qingyao's voice came again, this time with a more searching tone: 'It's nothing, just—the spiritual energy fluctuation just now was quite special. Brother Chen, are you truly alright?' A faint smile tugged at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, but he replied with a trembling voice: 'I'm fine, Sister. This disciple is merely a servant disciple—what could possibly happen to me?'

The footsteps outside the door gradually faded away, but Chen Ji's expression turned cold at that moment. Su Qingyao's intuition was as sharp as ever, repeatedly approaching the truth... it seemed he would need to be even more careful in future endeavors. He turned and walked back to the window, gazing at the gradually brightening dawn. In his mind, he rapidly calculated every move ahead. Holy Sect, blood sacrifice, Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the seventh page... these fragments constantly assembled in his heart, gradually outlining a vague yet grand picture. And at the center of that picture stood a choice he must face—to destroy the core of the ultimate chess player according to his father's dying wish, or to carve out a bloody path through this chess game by taking an entirely different route.

choice.prompt: The dawn light gradually illuminated the rooftops of the Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji stood at the window, having made his first decision. However, how to proceed from here still left him uncertain. His father's dying wish, his sister's safety, the truth of the Tianji Record... all of this intertwined, forcing him to act with caution. Master Mo's voice sounded softly in his Mental Sea: 'Young master, whatever choice you make, this old one will do his best to assist. But one thing you must remember—the complete form of the Tianji Record may not be as simple as you imagine.'

choices.description: Chen Nian is Chen Ji's biological sister—this matter of rescuing her should not be entrusted to others. He decided to use the foresight ability of the Tianji Record to infiltrate the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds alone and search for his sister. The risk is extremely high, but if successful, he can gain complete initiative.
choices.visible_cost: Isolated with no help, surrounded by enemies
choices.visible_reward: Claim sole credit and avoid leaks

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. He pushed open the window, and the cold morning wind poured into the room, stirring his hair. A moment later, a black figure shot out from the Rear Mountain, racing toward the southeast. That direction was precisely where the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds lay. Before departing, he cast one final glance toward the Tianqing Sect—Su Qingyao, your keen intuition was ultimately a step too late. When I return, everything will be revealed. He said silently in his heart, his form already vanishing into the dawn.

choices.description: Su Qingyao's combat power is formidable, and she is also the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow—with her assistance, endeavors would yield twice the result with half the effort. More importantly, by drawing her into the scheme, one can later act openly under her watchful eye, which can in turn conceal even more secrets.
choices.visible_cost: Expose one's whereabouts and need to explain the reasons
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful bodyguard and reduce risks
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao is suspicious by nature; things could go wrong.

text.content: Chen Ji pushed open the door, meeting Su Qingyao's scrutinizing gaze. He took a deep breath, assuming an expression of hesitation, as if struggling to speak, before finally lowering his voice as if making a firm decision: "Senior Sister Su, I won't beat around the bush... I have a favor to ask of you." Su Qingyao raised an eyebrow, waiting for his next words. Chen Ji spoke with visible difficulty: "My sister... was taken away by people from the Holy Sect. I received news that she might be used for some kind of ritual. I..." He raised his head, a pleading light flickering in his eyes. "I know my cultivation is weak, but I cannot watch her come to harm. Senior Sister, can you help me?" Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, then suddenly let out a light laugh: "Chen Ji, you've finally decided to tell the truth."

choices.text: First seek guidance from Mo Xiansheng.
choices.description: What father said was too vague, and the secrets of the Tianji Record are far from unraveled. Rather than acting rashly, it would be better to first consult Mo Xiansheng, to clarify the true meaning of the seventh page and the truth behind father's dying wishes.
choices.visible_cost: Time is pressing; my sister's safety is uncertain.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence and reduce risks.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may be hiding something.

text.content: Chen Ji closed the door and sat cross-legged on the bed. "Master," he silently called out in his heart, "what exactly does father mean by the Heavenly Fate ritual, the seventh page, the core of the Ultimate Chess Player...?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long while before slowly speaking: "Since the Young Master asks, this old servant will no longer conceal anything." His voice carried a sense of emotion. "The eighth page of the Tianji Record is called 'Realm Breaking,' capable of tearing through the veil of time and space, allowing one to briefly traverse between past and future. And the ninth page..." He paused. "The ninth page is the resting place of Heavenly Dao's will."

Just as Chen Ji was lost in the vortex of his choices, a violent fluctuation suddenly pulsed from the depths of his Mental Sea. The Tianji Record Fragment flipped open on its own, and on the yellowed page, a line of golden text slowly materialized: 'The seventh page resides within the one who holds the key to Heavenly Fate.' Chen Ji's entire body trembled, his pupils contracting sharply. The key to Heavenly Fate—wasn't that precisely the reason Chen Nian was imprisoned by the Holy Sect, as father had said? So that's how it is! The seventh page wasn't hidden in some secret place, but sealed within his sister's body! No wonder father said destroying the core of the Ultimate Chess Player required Chen Nian, no wonder the Holy Sect would go to any lengths to capture her... All of this, from the very beginning, was a game!

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a light of shock and fury mingling in his gaze. The Holy Sect capturing Chen Nian was not merely for some blood sacrifice—they wanted to extract the seventh page from within Chen Nian's body! Once they succeeded, the consequences would be unimaginable. He took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. "Master," he urgently asked in his heart, "what would happen if the seventh page were forcibly extracted?" Mo Xiansheng's voice was extremely heavy: "The Heavenly Fate Key and the seventh page have been symbiotic for thirteen years. Once forcibly separated, at best both would be destroyed; at worst... it would trigger Heavenly Fate's backlash, and within a thousand li, everything would turn into a barren land of death." Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly, his knuckles turning white. So this was what father truly wanted to tell him—not to go destroy some core, but to... protect Chen Nian!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly rose, walked to the window, and gazed toward the direction of the Tianqing Sect Main Peak in the distance, his eyes glittering with sharp light. "Holy Sect..." he murmured, a cold, sinister smile curling at the corner of his mouth. "It seems I've already seen through your fine calculations." He turned around, his gaze falling on the flickering oil lamp, the flame's shadow dancing across his face. "Father, rest assured." His voice was low yet firm. "I will never leave my sister's affairs to anyone else. As for that so-called Ultimate Chess Player..." He paused, a blade-sharp glint flashing in his eyes. "Since you asked me to destroy its core, I will destroy it for you to see."

text.content:
Dawn finally pierced through the clouds, scattering the first rays of sunlight across the Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji pushed open the window, letting the cold morning air rush into the room, dispersing the沉闷 and gloom within. His expression had returned to its usual calmness and woodenness, as if that sharp-eyed少年 had never existed. But in his heart, an unprecedented game of chess had already quietly unfolded. The Holy Sect, the Tianqing Sect, the Xuanwu Sect, Heavenly Dao's will... all the chess players believed they held fate's trajectory in their hands, unaware that the true chess master now stood at the edge of the board, watching coldly. "The seventh page..." he murmured to himself. "Since it's within my sister, I absolutely cannot let anyone take it." He stepped across the threshold, striding toward the direction outside the Tianqing Sect. Behind him, the oil lamp's flame flickered in the morning wind for a moment before finally extinguishing.

And just as Chen Ji was about to step through the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, a hoarse yet authoritative voice suddenly rang out from behind him: "Chen Ji, leaving so early?" Chen Ji's footsteps paused slightly. He turned around to find Ling Yuan standing with hands clasped behind his back on the stone steps nearby, his turbid old eyes gazing at him with a knowing smile. Those eyes were deep as an abyss, as if they could see through all pretense.
